business.signups.label: SelectaDJ for Business sign-up
business.signups.about: Self-serve business sign-up and selling of business plans. Off until the legal review passes; pilots work without it.

business.orgs.label: Organisations, venues, zones and crates
business.orgs.about: An organisation workspace with its venues, each venue's zones, and organisation and venue crates drawn from one shared library.

business.workspaces.label: Workspace switcher
business.workspaces.about: Switch between your personal SelectaDJ and the organisations you belong to. Personal and business data never mix.

business.pilots.label: Business pilots
business.pilots.about: REX Technologies staff create free pilot organisations with their venues and zones, using the same model a paying venue will.
